0022600149.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (1-4, 13th in the West, 5th in the Southwest) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East), with the Pelicans at 1-2 at home and the Hawks at 2-1 on the road. New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost 0-2, most recently 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
